description: Observation-keyed opening book (FOW_OPENING_BOOK). Fires only on these exact fog-of-war view fingerprints; inert elsewhere. White: force 2.Nc3 after any first move (king-trap block) + 3.Nf3 after 1.e4. See src/fow_chess/opening_book.py.
